before: Ask the project owner for: (1) the live website address, (2) a test admin account made just for you, (3) access to the inbox that receives website enquiries.
Use Chrome on a computer, plus one phone. Keep the Excel workbook open beside the browser.
Never type real student names, phone numbers or emails. Use names like 'TEST Ram' and emails like test+1@yourcompany.com.
Take a screenshot for every Fail (Windows: Win+Shift+S). Save it as TestID_short-name.png (for example FT-046_blog-not-found.png) and write the file name in the Remarks column.
Do not delete or change real content. When you test editing, add a new TEST item, check it, then delete it again.
bug: Something different from the 'Expected Result' column happens.
You see 'Something went wrong', a blank page, a spinning loader that never ends, or a 500 error.
A page says 'Saved' but the change is not on the website after a refresh.
Anything you typed in a form appears on the site as code, or a pop-up appears that you did not expect.
You can open an /admin page without signing in.
record: Status column: Pass, Fail, Blocked (you could not test it — say why in Remarks) or Not Tested.
Actual Result: write exactly what you saw, in one or two sentences.
For a Fail: add a new row in 'Bug Reports' (next Bug ID, title, steps, what you expected, what happened, screenshot name) and put that Bug ID in the test row.
After a developer fixes a bug: re-run the test, set 'Retest Status' to Pass or Fail, and add a row in 'Retesting and Regression'.

steps.do: Open the homepage. Scroll slowly from top to bottom.
steps.verify: Menu, hero, sections, footer all show. No broken pictures. Reels / Videos / Blog sections only appear if items were added.
steps.bug: Broken image, overlapping text, error page.

steps.where: Every page in the top menu and footer
steps.do: Click each menu and footer link once.
steps.verify: Each page opens with its own title and content.
steps.bug: 'Page not found' or an error on a real link.

steps.do: Repeat steps 1–2 on a phone. Open the ☰ menu.
steps.verify: No sideways scrolling, text readable, buttons easy to tap.
steps.bug: Page wider than the screen, cut-off text.

steps.do: Click Send with the form empty.
steps.verify: A red message under every required field. Nothing is sent.

steps.do: Fill the form with bad data and click Send.
steps.data: Email: abc   Phone: hello   Message: hi
steps.verify: 'Please enter a valid email address', phone and message errors.

steps.do: Fill the form correctly and send.
steps.data: Name: TEST Ram, Phone: +977 9800000000, Email: test+1@yourcompany.com, Subject: TEST, Message: This is a test message, tick consent
steps.verify: Success message on screen AND the email arrives in the office inbox with all fields.
steps.bug: Error message, or nothing arrives in the inbox within 5 minutes.

steps.do: Repeat steps 4–6. Choose a programme, then check only countries offering it are allowed.
steps.data: Programme: MBBS, Country: China, Mode: Online
steps.verify: Validation messages for bad data; success + inbox email for good data.
steps.bug: A programme/country pair that is not offered is accepted.

steps.do: Type the address /admin in the browser without signing in.
steps.verify: You are sent to the login page.

steps.do: Sign in with a wrong password.
steps.verify: 'Incorrect email or password.'
steps.bug: Signs in, or says the email doesn't exist.

steps.do: Sign in with your test account.
steps.verify: Dashboard 'Welcome, …' with Pages and Shared content cards.

steps.do: Click 'Add reel'. Enter a title and a TikTok or Facebook reel link. Click Save. Open the homepage in a new tab and refresh.
steps.data: Title: TEST reel   Link: a real public reel link starting https://
steps.verify: 'Saved'. The homepage 'Reels' section shows the card with 'Watch on TikTok/Facebook'; clicking it opens the reel in a new tab.
steps.bug: Card missing, wrong platform name, link goes elsewhere.

steps.do: Add a reel whose link has no https:// and Save.
steps.verify: Expected: a warning that the link is invalid. Known bug BUG-005: it says Saved and the reel silently disappears.

steps.do: Add a YouTube video link and Save. Open /videos.
steps.verify: The video plays inside the page.

steps.do: Add a post: title, date, summary, two paragraphs. Leave 'Web address' empty. Save. Open /blog, then click the post.
steps.verify: Post appears first on /blog and its page shows the text. Known bug BUG-003: the very first open may say 'This page has moved on' — refresh once and note it.
steps.bug: Post never appears, or still 'moved on' after refresh.

steps.do: Untick 'Show on website' on one section, Save, check the homepage; then tick it again and Save.
steps.verify: Section disappears, then comes back.

steps.where: Any image field (e.g. Reels → Cover picture)
steps.do: Upload a JPG under 5 MB; then try a PDF and a file over 5 MB.
steps.verify: JPG uploads and shows. PDF: 'Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or GIF image.' Large: 'Images must be 5 MB or smaller.'

steps.where: Any text field in the Admin Panel
steps.do: Type this into a title, Save, and view the site.
steps.verify: The text appears literally on the page. No pop-up.
steps.bug: A pop-up appears (serious — stop and report).

steps.do: Change your password with a wrong current password; then with a weak new one; then correctly.
steps.data: New password: at least 10 characters with letters and numbers
steps.verify: Clear error for the first two; 'Password changed.' for the last; old password stops working.

steps.do: Log out, then press the browser Back button and refresh.
steps.verify: You are on the login page, admin content not shown.

steps.do: Delete every TEST reel, video and post you created, Save each list, and check the site again.
steps.verify: No TEST items remain on the live site.
